authorization: User requested a new hybrid of our refitted pair and RandomForest, independent of teammate implementation.
hypothesis: A shallow MAE-split random forest can supply complementary nonlinear predictions to the refitted liquidation pair.
training_history: Expanding; same previously verified quarterly outer pair models are reused.
forest_notes: Average of median-valued leaves, not an exact ensemble conditional median. Random bootstrap samples use past training rows only and are not used for validation. Fixed 4096 samples/tree bounds runtime; no hyperparameter search.
preprocessing: Training-only median fill, center, scale and missing flags; same two inputs as pair.
weight_selection: For each outer fold, fit pair and forest before the prior 3-calendar-month validation interval, purge labels at both boundaries, then choose lowest inner MAE; exact ties favor smaller forest weight. Refit outer forest on all matured outer training labels and reuse corresponding outer pair. No outer labels select weights.
fit_accounting: 4 inner pair + 4 inner forest + 4 outer forest + 4 scalar blend selections. 4 saved outer pair fits reused. Previous session fits 39; planned cumulative 55.
metric: MAE on original identical 18481 development origins
stopping_rule: Complete these two preregistered hybrid policies and report all results; no development-optimized blend sweep or further automatic search.
